"""Freeze full V168 endpoint review,independent metrics and native rendering."""
import ast,os,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);previous=Path(plan['previous']);old=previous/'postprocess-v1/scripts';post=root/'postprocess-v1/scripts';post.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name in ['train_v43_quality_trial.py','report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet.py','profile_raw_kernel_inference.py','report_checkpoint_pilot.py','train_directional_bank_trial.py']:shutil.copyfile(old/name,post/name)
shutil.copyfile(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/review_fine_mesh_trial.py',post/'review_fine_mesh_trial.py')
for name in ['score','audit','render']:
 s=(old/f'{name}_bounded_support_trial.py').read_text().replace('_bounded_support_trial','_fine_mesh_trial').replace('V167','V168')
 s=s.replace('routed-control','legacy-control').replace('bounded-support','fine-mesh')
 s=s.replace('Routed ctrl raw1k','Legacy ctrl raw1k').replace('Routed ctrl EMA1k','Legacy ctrl EMA1k').replace('Bounded support raw1k','Fine mesh raw1k').replace('Bounded support EMA1k','Fine mesh EMA1k')
 s=s.replace('stronger-pair control and pair-common objective','legacy-data control and fine-mesh distribution')
 ast.parse(s);(post/f'{name}_fine_mesh_trial.py').write_text(s)
retained=read(previous/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')['retained_native_collections'];assert len(retained)==8
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
for b in retained.values():
 assert ref(b['path'])==b;c=read(b['path']);assert [r['id'] for r in c['observations']]==[v['id'] for v in cases]
 assert all(r['parent']==v['parent'] for r,v in zip(c['observations'],cases,strict=True))
save(root/'native-retained-comparators-v1.json',{'collections':retained,'new_forwards':0,'scope':'Eight retained V156raw/V157/V158/V159EMA/V160ordinary+pairedEMA/V161EMA/V162EMA columns. Current control is V167 bounded support,all822 inputs/parents match. No retained neural forwards.'})
shared=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103';metrics=[shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py',shared/'collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py',shared/'V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py']
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post,Path(plan['work'])/'scripts',Path(plan['work'])/'src']),OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
command='from pathlib import Path;from score_fine_mesh_trial import load_module;'+f'r=Path({str(shared)!r});'
command+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py","errors");load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py","independent_late_spectral_metrics");load_module(r/"V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py","photos");'
command+='import review_fine_mesh_trial,audit_fine_mesh_trial,render_fine_mesh_trial;print("PASS actual V168 reviewer/independent metrics/render imports")'
run=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',command],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True);assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
save(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json',{'returncode':run.returncode,'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr,'command':command,
 'metrics':[ref(p) for p in metrics],'retained_native_collections':retained,'sources':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')},'new_forwards':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print('Frozen9 postprocess sources/eight retained columns/822cases/72native images')
